summary: Nine per-provider adapter modules that convert a provider's StorageProfile settings into SDK-ready kwargs dicts. One adapter per provider: s3.py (boto3 kwargs, with flavor dispatch for R2 endpoint, Express session tokens), azure.py (azure.storage.blob / azure.storage.fileshare kwargs), gcs.py (google-cloud-storage kwargs), ssh.py (paramiko.SSHClient.connect kwargs), ftp.py (ftplib.FTP/FTP_TLS kwargs), smb.py (smbprotocol Session kwargs), local.py (pass-through + optional MOUNT_SPEC), github.py (fsspec.GithubFileSystem kwargs), http.py (httpx.Client kwargs). All SDK imports are lazy to avoid import errors when optional dependencies are absent.
extension_points: New backends require a new adapter module following the existing pattern
lifecycle_notes: Lazy SDK imports in adapters prevent ImportError when a provider's SDK is not installed
s3.py adapter dispatches on FLAVOR to set endpoint_url and session token for R2, Express, MinIO, B2
risks: Adapter logic drift from SDK documentation causes silent misconfiguration
